except Exception as e:
    print('Error:', type(e).__name__, e)

# Check if there's an issue with very large seconds values

    print('naturaldelta of 1e20 seconds:', repr(naturaldelta(1e20)))
except Exception as e:
    print('Error:', type(e).__name__, e)
